pricingTitle: Choose the plan that fits your trading intelligence needs
pricingSubtitle: Start free. Upgrade as you scale. Cancel anytime — built for individuals, active traders, and enterprise research desks.
freePlanDescription: For retail investors exploring global markets at their own pace.
proPlanDescription: For active traders and analysts who track multiple asset classes daily.
enterprisePlanDescription: For research desks, funds, and teams that need custom data, SSO, and dedicated support.
proFeature5: Crypto + Forex + Stocks in one workspace

pricingAllPlansInclude: All plans include bank-grade encryption and 99.9% uptime SLA.
includedSubtitle: Powerful fundamentals come standard — upgrade only when you need more depth, speed, or seats.
included1Desc: Streaming quotes from 30+ global exchanges across equities, FX, crypto, and commodities.
included2Desc: Unified workspace across asset classes — no tab switching, no context loss.
included3Desc: Daily sentiment, anomaly detection, and natural-language market briefings.
included4Desc: Responsive web, tablet, and mobile — your workspace follows you across devices.
included5Desc: Custom price, volume, and volatility alerts delivered to email or push.
included6Desc: AES-256 encryption, SOC 2 controls, and GDPR-aligned data handling on every tier.
breakdownTitle: A complete look at every feature
breakdownSubtitle: Drill into the specifics — what each plan delivers, line by line.
breakdown1Desc: Global equities, regional indices, FX majors and exotics, crypto majors and DeFi, plus commodities across energy, metals, and agriculture.
breakdown1More: Includes pre-market, after-hours, and weekend crypto sessions where applicable.
breakdown2Desc: Streaming quotes, historical tick data, advanced charting, screeners, heatmaps, and exportable CSV / JSON datasets.
breakdown2More: Pro adds unlimited saved screeners and backtest-ready exports.
breakdown3Desc: Daily market summaries, sentiment scoring, earnings call analysis, and anomaly detection on price/volume moves.
breakdown3More: Enterprise unlocks custom AI prompts and private model endpoints.
breakdown4Desc: Price, volume, volatility, and corporate-event alerts delivered to email, push, or webhook with quiet-hours support.
breakdown4More: Pro enables 100+ concurrent alerts; Enterprise removes the cap entirely.
breakdown5Desc: AES-256 encryption in transit and at rest, SSO/SAML, SCIM, audit logs, and configurable data residency.
breakdown5More: Enterprise includes SOC 2 Type II report and DPA on request.
breakdown6Desc: REST and WebSocket APIs, Zapier and Make connectors, plus CSV/JSON import and export for every plan.
breakdown6More: Enterprise adds custom integrations and dedicated integration support.
compareTitle: Compare every plan side by side
compareSubtitle: The full matrix — no hidden limits, no asterisks.
faqSubtitle: Everything you need to know before you choose a plan.
faq1A: Yes — Professional comes with a 14-day free trial. No credit card required to start, and you can downgrade to Free at any time.
faq2A: Absolutely. Upgrade or downgrade from your account settings and the new pricing is prorated to the day.
faq3A: Yes. Enterprise customers get custom data feeds, SSO/SCIM, on-prem deployment, and dedicated onboarding. Contact sales to scope your rollout.
faq4A: Real-time streaming is included from Professional upward. Free uses 15-minute delayed quotes so you can explore the workspace risk-free.
faq5Q: How accurate is your market data?
faq5A: We source from regulated exchange feeds and licensed aggregators. Every quote is timestamped and reconciled at session close.
